items.title: Natural Gas Spot Prices Reverse Lower on Mixed Weather Outlook
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices for the Labor Day Weekend package plummeted on Friday, led lower by a steep reversal in the Eastern Lower 48 and South Louisiana after meteoric gains the day before.

items.title: Unseasonable Heat Boosting Natural Gas Futures, but Could Soon Wear Out Its Welcome
items.summary: Prompt month natural gas futures clawed their way to a fourth straight weekly gain on Friday amid impressive late summer cooling demand, tightening storage balances and rejuvenated LNG feedgas flows.

items.title: Labor Day Storms Cool Southeast, Ease Natural Gas Pipeline Restrictions

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Take Another Run at $3 as Heat, LNG Lend Support
items.summary: Natural gas futures strengthened Friday, with buying concentrated at the front of the curve while Henry Hub cash prices eased. Lower production and a warmer extended outlook helped underpin the market.

items.title: Cipher Turns to Natural Gas for Data Center Power Expansion
items.summary: Industrial-scale data center developer Cipher Digital is developing lateral pipelines to deliver natural gas to multiple sites, laying the groundwork for up to 2.5 GW of on-site generation targeted to become available before the end of 2027.

items.title: California Natural Gas Generation Roars Back as Summer Tests Battery Buffer

items.title: New England’s January Natural Gas Prices Retreat From $22 as Egress Advances
items.summary: Forward curves at key New England natural gas hubs are pricing substantial relief in subsequent years following an exceptional winter premium in the coming heating season.

items.title: Will Resilient Summer Demand Buck Up Natural Gas Futures?
items.summary: Natural gas futures ticked up early Friday as market participants digested a narrowing but still substantial storage surplus, choppy yet seasonally solid production, robust late-summer cooling demand and strong LNG volumes.
